  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 30mg, 망간 3mg, 비오틴 60μg, 비타민 B1 2.4mg, 비타민 B12 4.8μg, 비타민 B2 2.8mg, 비타민 B6 3mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 비타민 E 11mg, 셀레늄 55μg, 아연 8.5mg, 엽산 1000μg, 판토텐산 10mg

닥터 프레그맘 스텝-1Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 주식회사 상상바이오 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 30mg of Niacin, 3mg of Manganese, 60μg of Biotin, 2.4mg of Vitamin B1, 4.8μg of Vitamin B12, 2.8mg of Vitamin B2, 3mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 1000μg of Folate, 10mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 30mg Niacin, 3mg Manganese, 60μg Biotin, 2.4mg Vitamin B1, 4.8μg Vitamin B12, 2.8mg Vitamin B2, 3mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 1000μg Folate, 10mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 상상바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (30mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (60μg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (2.4mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (4.8μg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (2.8mg / 900mg), 80~180%

Selenium labelled (55μg / 900mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (1000μg / 900mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (10mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 불규칙한 점박이를 포함한 밝은 노란 주황색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage ① 직사광선 및 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관 하십시오. ③ 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

주)팜크로스 제조 · 1일 1회 1정

이 제품은 나이아신 15mg, 망간 3mg, 비오틴 30μg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 비타민 E 11mg, 셀레늄 55μg, 아연 8.5mg, 엽산 800μg, 판토텐산 5mg를 표시량으로 담은 14원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 15mg, 망간 3mg, 비오틴 30μg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 비타민 E 11mg, 셀레늄 55μg, 아연 8.5mg, 엽산 800μg, 판토텐산 5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 연한 황갈색의 장방형 제피정제 · 주)팜크로스 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 나이아신
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 망간
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
    • 뼈 형성에 필요
    • 에너지 이용에 필요
  • 비오틴
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B1
    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B12
    • 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B2
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 셀레늄
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
  • 엽산
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
    • 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요
  • 판토텐산
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요

Made by 주)팜크로스 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 3mg of Manganese, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 800μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 3mg Manganese, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 800μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주)팜크로스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
